reforms.description: The Federal budget includes a Special Recovery Program aimed at boosting private fixed investment through enhanced investment tax credits and the establishment of Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing.
reforms.component_name: Investment Tax Credits and Recovery Funds
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The program is designed to enhance private investment, which is expected to stimulate economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform was announced as part of the Federal budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform represents a significant policy change aimed at boosting private investment through tax incentives.
reforms.source_quote: A Special Recovery Program, costed at $4.8 billion over 4 years and consisting of two major parts: incentives to boost private fixed investment... through enhancement of investment tax credits.

reforms.description: The Federal budget promotes technology and R&D expenditure as part of its measures to stimulate economic growth.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Promoting technology and R&D expenditure is expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform was part of the Federal budget announcements.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, this reform is not as major as the Special Recovery Program.
reforms.source_quote: Measures to stimulate residential investment, including promotion of technology and R&D expenditure.
